criterion: For an uploaded PDF, can the PDF lane complete from that PDF alone?

classes.A: needs the uploaded PDF itself -> change the API to take an explicit PDF path or source
classes.B: looks for a sidecar because of the legacy DOCX workflow -> legacy dependency
classes.C: corpus or eval discovery -> must leave production
classes.D: genuinely needs a companion file -> the caller must pass it explicitly; never scan the filesystem

hardRule: No production lane may walk up from the current working directory, rewrite a corpus path segment, or do a recursive filename match to find an input.

discoveryHelper.assessment: Branches two and three are class C by construction: they encode an evaluation dataset layout and depend on the process working directory. They cannot stay in a production path under any classification of the call site.
